claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 518 A10 rectangles in one A1 rectangle.
claims.evidence: The three stated families contain respectively 2·32=64, 14, and 20·22=440 rectangles, totaling 518. Their occupied regions are [0,74]×[0,832], [74,592]×[0,26], and [74,594]×[26,840]. Each rectangle has dimensions 37×26 or 26×37, every coordinate lies in [0,594]×[0,841], and the regions have disjoint interiors. The exact checker generated all 518 rectangles, checked every covered unit cell for overlap, and found 498316=518·37·26 covered cells and 1238 uncovered container cells.
claims.search_method: Direct symbolic boundary/disjointness analysis followed by exhaustive exact-integer unit-cell verification of the generated placement.

claims.claim: No packing can contain 519 A10 rectangles; a ten-residue periodic marker certificate gives the upper bound 518.
claims.evidence: For the ten listed residue pairs modulo 37, exact enumeration of all 37 cyclic starts shows that every length-26 interval contains 7 or 8 selected first-coordinate residues and 7 or 8 selected second-coordinate residues. Thus every integer-positioned 37×26 or 26×37 rectangle contains at least 7 marked unit cells. In 594 columns, residues 0 and 1 occur 17 times and the other residues occur 16 times; no selected first coordinate is 0 or 1. In 841 rows, residues 0 through 26 occur 23 times and the rest occur 22 times; seven selected second coordinates are in the former group and three in the latter. Hence the exact marker total is 16(7·23+3·22)=3632. Interior-disjoint integer rectangles cover disjoint marked unit cells, so 519 rectangles would require at least 7·519=3633 marks, impossible. The real-coordinate case reduces rigorously to the integer case: with vertical coordinates fixed, minimize the sum of horizontal coordinates over the compact feasible set; every nonboundary rectangle then has a left blocker, and following blockers to x=0 expresses its coordinate as a sum of integral widths. Holding those integral horizontal coordinates fixed and applying the analogous minimization vertically makes all vertical coordinates integral. The checker independently built the full marker grid and exhaustively found marked-cell ranges 7–8 over all 455328 placements of size 37×26 and all 458045 placements of size 26×37.
claims.witness: Periodic marker set P={(3,3),(7,25),(10,14),(14,7),(18,29),(22,11),(25,33),(29,22),(33,36),(36,18)} modulo 37; total container marks 3632, while 519 rectangles require at least 3633.
claims.search_method: Independent proof of the integer-coordinate reduction, exact residue-multiplicity calculation, enumeration of every cyclic interval, and exhaustive exact-integer prefix-sum evaluation of every feasible integer placement in both orientations.

target_evidence: The exact target is numerically inconsistent: for the literal supplied ISO dimensions, A10-in-A1 is not a 258-versus-259 problem. The verified construction alone places 518 A10 rectangles in A1 and therefore disproves both proposed alternatives. The independently verified marker certificate proves that 519 is impossible, establishing the stronger exact result OPT(594,841,37,26)=518 and supplying both requested kinds of checkable certificate. Consequently the draft fully resolves the literal target by identifying and correcting its false dichotomy, and its claimed FULL resolution is accurate.
checks_performed: Read only the authorized source-input JSON and baseline-draft JSON.
Generated all 518 placement rectangles and checked exact dimensions, containment, uniqueness, and unit-cell disjointness.
Confirmed exactly 498316 covered cells and 1238 uncovered cells in the 594×841 container.
Enumerated all 37 cyclic starts for the selected first- and second-coordinate residues and confirmed every length-26 count is 7 or 8.
Calculated the marker total independently from exact residue multiplicities and also by constructing the complete marker grid; both gave 3632.
Exhaustively evaluated all 455328 integer placements of size 37×26 and all 458045 placements of size 26×37 with integer prefix sums; both orientations had marker sums ranging from 7 to 8.
Audited the reduction from arbitrary real coordinates to integer coordinates using compactness, coordinate-sum minimization, and finite blocker chains.
